note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Objects are joined to list rows exactly as supplied; an object without an entry is only described, never judged. No custody or admissibility doctrine. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState.
